habitat: Coastal bush and the edges of lowland evergreen forest. Further inland it is a bird of evergreen riparian growth, and it visits well-vegetated gardens.
summary: No Newman page. SABAP1 says it is similar to Marico Sunbird and that the two do not overlap widely. The male has an eclipse plumage, mainly December to May. Reporting drops from late summer to early winter, and Zimbabwe birds leave the plateau from December and return in May. No plumage colours, length or call are given. The Kemp code VB was left unchanged.

research.note: No Newman page. SABAP1 describes seasonal movement and an eclipse plumage but not the months in Kruger, so status and monthsPresent are unset. Wikipedia gives no total length, so size is omitted. Population figures and the Kemp code VB were left unchanged.

similar.note: SABAP1 says Purple-banded Sunbird is similar to Marico Sunbird, and that the two do not overlap widely in the region.
